summary: A wizard specializing in changing matter and living forms.

feature.name: Transmuter’s Stone
feature.summary: Constitution save proficiency and one stone benefit, changed after a Long Rest.
feature.text: After a Long Rest you craft a Tiny transmuter's stone; you carry it and gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws plus one benefit you pick: Darkvision 60 feet, Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder, or +10 feet Speed. You can change the benefit after a Long Rest. (The book lets you hand the stone to someone else and change it with a Transmutation spell; in the game you keep it.)

feature.name: Wondrous Alteration
feature.summary: Cast Alter Self without a slot once per Long Rest. Its Aquatic Adaptation adds Bonus Action Dash underwater; Change Appearance adds Advantage on Deception; Natural Weapons deals 2d6 and grants Advantage on Concentration saves.
feature.text: You can cast Alter Self without a spell slot once per Long Rest. Its Natural Weapons deal 2d6 damage and give you Advantage on Concentration saves; Aquatic Adaptation also lets you Dash underwater as a Bonus Action and Change Appearance gives Advantage on Deception checks (those two play out outside fights).

feature.name: Empowered Transmutation
feature.summary: When casting a Transmutation spell with a slot that makes no attack roll and forces no save, increase its effective level by 1. Uses equal Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.
feature.text: When casting a Transmutation spell with a slot that makes no attack roll and forces no save, increase its effective level by 1. Uses equal Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

feature.name: Potent Stone
feature.summary: The stone grants two benefits; Resistance can be chosen twice for different types, other options once. Slotted Transmutation can change either or both. New options: Mighty Build (Advantage on Strength saves, carrying capacity as one size larger) and Tremorsense 30 feet.
feature.text: Your stone grants a second benefit (a second Resistance must be a different type). Two more options join the list: Mighty Build (Advantage on Strength saves and carrying as one size larger) and Tremorsense 30 feet.

options.name: Mighty Build: Advantage on Strength saves, carry as one size larger
options.summary: Mighty Build: Advantage on Strength saves, carry as one size larger.

feature.name: Shape-Shifter
feature.summary: Cast Polymorph without a slot once per Long Rest. Once per Long Rest when targeting yourself, retain memories, communication, mental ability scores, proficiencies, class features, and feats; you can cast Transmutation spells without costly or consumed Material components in that form.
feature.text: You can cast Polymorph without a spell slot once per Long Rest. Once per Long Rest when you Polymorph yourself, you keep your mind: your Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma and your Proficiency Bonus (the game's Polymorph form keeps these like Wild Shape; your class features and feats stay with your true form).

feature.name: Master Transmuter
feature.summary: While carrying your stone, a Magic action consumes it for one benefit; a level 7+ slot prevents destruction. Major Transformation: handle a nonmagical object for 10 minutes, converting it to a similar-size/mass object of equal or lower value, at most a 10-foot Cube or eight connected 5-foot Cubes. Panacea: touch heals half target maximum HP (round down), ends magical contagions, curses including cursed Attunement, Poisoned, and Petrified. Restore Life: cast Raise Dead without a slot, using the stone for materials. Restore Youth: touch a willing creature, remove all Exhaustion and make it appear 3d10 years younger, no younger than young adulthood.
feature.text: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action, you pour your stone's power into one of these: Panacea (a creature you touch regains half its Hit Point maximum and is cured of curses, Poisoned and Petrified), Restore Youth (a willing creature you touch loses all its Exhaustion and looks 3d10 years younger), Restore Life (Raise Dead without a slot, outside a fight) or Major Transformation (reshape a nonmagical object, outside a fight). The book destroys the stone unless you spend a level 7+ slot; in the game the stone stays.
